First release of Driver.

**Download `Driver-Setup.exe`** to install (Start menu, desktop shortcut and a firewall rule so friends can join you). `Driver-portable.exe` runs without installing.

- Three maps: Green Hollow, Red Canyon and Frostline Peak
- Free roam, timed routes, delivery jobs and hidden landmarks
- Winch onto trees, rocks, buildings or a friend's truck
- Co-op for up to 4 players over LAN or Tailscale (UDP port 24560)
- Keyboard and controller, fully rebindable

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the installer is not code signed. Choose More info, then Run anyway.
